heading: What I Specialize In
content: From research and visual design to front-end development, I create digital experiences that are functional, engaging, and built with attention to every detail.

items.title: UI/UX Design
items.content: I design intuitive and user-centered interfaces for websites and mobile applications, balancing usability with modern visual aesthetics. Every design decision is guided by user needs, business goals, and a seamless experience.

items.title: Graphic Design
items.content: I create impactful visual assets ranging from posters and key visuals to social media campaigns. When appropriate, I incorporate 3D elements to bring depth, creativity, and a distinctive visual identity to each design.

items.title: Web Development
items.content: I bring designs to life through front-end development, building responsive and interactive websites with clean, maintainable code. I also create smooth animations and user interactions to enhance the overall experience.
